title: Catalina VPC onboarding — weekly sync prep and action log
content:
Meeting context: weekly sync with Catalina infra/Platform (customer) + SE + Solutions Eng + SRE. Goal: track milestones for VPC/on‑prem install, unblock infra tasks, confirm acceptance test cadence and cutover window. Quick note: this is my personal prep + running action log — not the canonical customer minutes.

Agenda (30-40m):
- 5m: quick state check (what's green/red since last week)
- 10m: network & security blockers (peering, firewall rules, certs)
- 10m: runtime deployment & HV/acceptance tests (image signing, KV cache smoke, perf test plan)
- 5m: schedule next steps + owners + timeline recs

Top-line status (my read):
- Overall: progressing but blocked by customer PKI cert cadence and GCP VPC-SCC peering window.
- Milestones: network peering (partial), image validation (blocked by signing key access), acceptance tests (draft ready), audit log forwarding (waiting for collector IPs).

Milestone tracker (owner | current state | immediate blocker):
- Network peering MVP | Owner: Diego Morales | state: partial (subnets shared) | blocker: customer needs security approval for cross-project peering (ticket sent to their NetSec 2025-02-26).
- Firewall and NAT rules | Owner: Customer-NetOps (contact: sjones@catalina.io) | state: pending | blocker: missing IP ranges for control-plane egress (I requested 2/20).
- Image signing / runtime validation | Owner: Nina (me) & Infra Eng | state: blocked | blocker: KMS/HSM permission grant (customer needs to add our service account to their KMS list).
- KMS/HSM integration | Owner: Priya Singh | state: awaiting creds | blocker: legal appendix (HSM access SLA) — Sales/Legal loop required.
- Audit log forwarding & SIEM | Owner: Customer-SOC + SRE | state: queued | blocker: collector IPs + log format spec (I attached sample mapping 2025-02-17).
- Acceptance tests (smoke/perf) | Owner: SRE test lead | state: draft | blocker: no stable image in their registry to run golden tests against (depends on image signing).
- E2E cutover window planning | Owner: Solutions Eng (Diego) | state: planning | blocker: date conflicts with Catalina change freeze week (Mar 10-14).

Open blockers (priority order):
1) KMS/HSM access — legal + security sign-off. Action: loop Legal (Emily Chen) for appendix; ask Sales to expedite e-sig. Target: 2025-03-06. Owner: Priya (reach out to Emily + Sales).
2) Customer NetSec approval for peering — needs a short architecture blurb + risk notes. Action: Diego to send concise security blurb + diagram by EOD 2025-03-04. Owner: Diego.
3) Collector IPs for audit/syslog — customer to provide list. Action: Nina to ping customer SOC (cc: Diego) and suggest temporary NAT-based forwarding if IPs delayed. Owner: Nina.
4) Image signing permission — need service account binding to KMS key. Action: prepare step-by-step docs and a one-click script; attach to help ticket. Due: 2025-03-05. Owner: Nina + Infra Eng.

Prep notes for call (things I will say / confirm):
- Confirm change freeze dates (repeat: Mar 10-14) and whether we must shift cutover earlier.
- Ask for a short security contact list (NetSec, SOC, PKI owner) with emails and timezone.
- Reiterate rollback/fallback options — highlight hosted fallback to avoid downtime.
- Suggest a two-day pre-cutover rehearsal in staging (run acceptance smoke + perf run @ 50% load).

Agenda items for 1:1 with Diego (before sync) — schedule 20m today (Nina + Diego):
- Quick status on NetSec blurb + who at customer will sign off.
- Confirm support window for cutover (on-call SRE coverage) and possible extra ops headcount.
- Discuss whether we can do temporary bypass for image signing (short-lived dev key) to allow tests while legal completes HSM appendix.

Follow-ups and action items (running list):
- [Nina] Draft image-signing quick-guide + script and upload to GH repo -> due 2025-03-05. (linked: PR #238)
- [Priya] Start legal thread for HSM appendix; get initial position from Legal (Emily Chen) -> due 2025-03-06.
- [Diego] Send NetSec blurb + network diagram to customer NetSec -> due 2025-03-04.
- [SRE Test Lead] Finalize acceptance test checklist (smoke + perf) and share runbook -> due 2025-03-07.
- [Nina] Ping customer SOC for collector IPs and fallback NAT option -> due 2025-03-03 (today).
- [Customer NetOps] Provide control-plane egress IP ranges -> due 2025-03-05.

Notes to self (scratch):
- If HSM appendix stalls >1 week, propose short-lived tokenized signing path (not HSM) for staging only; document risk and expiration.
- Keep the cutover window flexible but try to avoid the customer freeze week — propose Mar 5-7 as backup.
- Make sure cost/throughput expectations are written for the cutover doc so finance doesn't surprise them.

Risks & mitigation: 
- Risk: Legal delays on HSM cause test paralysis -> Mitigation: temporary dev-sign key + explicit expiry + audit trail.
- Risk: Network approval takes 2+ weeks -> Mitigation: propose VPN-with-NAT fallback for initial data-plane testing.
- Risk: Audit logs format mismatch -> Mitigation: ingest adapter on our side; request sample logs early.

Parking lot (non-blocking items to raise later):
- Hardening checklist post-cutover: runtime metrics retention, debug hooks, debug-mode deployments.
- Post-cutover runbook rehearsal date: schedule 2 weeks after cutover.
- Customer asks about support tiers / extended SLAs — connect to AE.

Customer touchpoints (contacts I have):
- Samuel Jones (NetOps) — sjones@catalina.io (primary for firewall/NAT)
- Leila Moreno (SOC) — lmoreno@catalina.io (audit logs)
- Rahul Desai (PKI) — rahul@catalina.io (certs/KMS contact)

Tomorrow's quick checklist (what I will do before sync):
- Re-send collector IP request (if no reply by 10am PT)
- Upload image signing guide draft and link in meeting chat
- Pull the latest acceptance test checklist and mark any gaps we cannot run yet
- Confirm Diego's NetSec blurb delivered -> if not, reschedule sync by 48h

Unresolved questions to bring up on the call: 
- Can Catalina create a short-lived service account binding for KMS with 'encrypt/decrypt' limited scope for us?
- Will they accept temporary NAT-forwarding for logs (if collector IPs delayed)?
- Any objections to running a perf test at 50% traffic during staging?

End of notes — will convert to formal minutes after the call and push a tidy action list to Confluence.

Last quick personal note: breathe. keep the list prioritized; legal/NetSec are the usual slow bits — target to escalate via AE if stalled by Friday.
